author: Cynthesis
body:
The map developer team is doing a really good job at creating new, fun maps to play on, and I greatly appreciate their efforts. However, I do have some suggestions for future maps:

  • Please don't put gravel and iron on the same map. Recently, I've been having a lot of problems with people using an FNS to team grief.
  • On any map that has a blue team, don't put lapis in all of the players' inventories. I know they need to be used for enchantments, but people on the other team can use the lapis to dye their armor blue and disguise themselves as blue players. The blue team, however, can't do that, giving the other team an unfair advantage.
  • I feel as though most of the maps in the TDM rotations are OH KO maps instead of actual pvp maps. Try mixing it up a bit so players don't find it...monotonous.
Thank you for your time and for taking these ideas into account. Hope to see you all online! :)
- Regards, Cyneric_
